verdict.rationale: Stable offers a virtual business address and, from the same provider, a nationwide registered agent service with filing automation and guidance. Its API can create both CMRA and registered-agent Locations tied to a Company, so address and entity-compliance services can be paired under one account. However, none of the specific entity services named in the story are evidenced. Missing for 10: LLC/entity formation, lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, residency-grade addresses, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pair the address with entity services — LLC formation, lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, or residency-grade addresses — from the same provider

citations.quote: Stable helps businesses stay compliant with a nationwide registered agent service that centralizes mail management and automates filings.
Stable provides automated filing guidance, prefilled forms, and validation support, saving hours of manual work.
Use your unique business address with the IRS, the state, vendors, and more.
An IATA-style code (e.g. `SFO1`) creates a CMRA. A 2-letter state code (e.g. `WY`) creates a registered agent location.
